description: Renovate manages ONLY the Maven dependencies embedded in the Eclipse target platform definitions.
pom.xml and GitHub Actions are handled by Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml).
The p2 update sites (<repository>/<unit> entries) are updated manually on a quarterly schedule and are deliberately out of scope.

customManagers.description: Maven <dependency> entries inside the <location type="Maven"> blocks of the target definitions. The p2 <repository>/<unit> elements carry no groupId/artifactId/version tags and therefore never match.

packageRules.description: PDFBox 1.8 is deliberately kept next to 3.x for the legacy PDF extractors. name.abuchen.portfolio.pdfbox1 requires org.apache.pdfbox [1.8.17,2.0.0), so never leave the 1.x line.
PDFBox 3.x artifacts move together. name.abuchen.portfolio.pdfbox3 requires org.apache.pdfbox [3.0.3,4.0.0), so a 4.x bump needs a manual manifest change and is blocked here.
ASM artifacts are released as one unit.
TwelveMonkeys ImageIO artifacts share a release train across both group ids.
Jackson core artifacts are released together.
json-path pulls in the matching json-smart/accessors-smart pair.
Guava and its failureaccess companion are released together; stay on the -jre flavour, the -android builds target older APIs.
The treemap bundles are published in the project's own Maven repo, not on Maven Central.
